description: This file defines kernel package configurations for a Linux build system, specifically for the openwrt project targeting layerscape hardware platform. It includes definitions for the 'ahci-qoriq' SATA support and 'ppfe' driver support, specifying their dependencies, source files, and load mechanisms.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ahci-qoriq
methods.description: Defines the configuration for Freescale QorIQ AHCI SATA support kernel package.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ppfe
methods.description: Defines the configuration for the Freescale PPFE driver support kernel package.
